evidence: Motion smearing produces doubled lettering and soft edges across the television menu, reducing readability despite recognizable text and colors.
A large soft foreground surface blocks much of the room, while deep underexposure conceals detail in the table objects and seating.
The sculpture edges, surface marks, and surrounding vegetation retain clear detail, with a soft gray obstruction confined to the right edge.
Dense colored grain covers the sky, walls, and hillside, degrading fine texture while building edges and most scene detail remain distinguishable.
A large finger obscures most of the image and part of the bottle, while blur and grain further damage the remaining label detail.
Heavy colored noise blankets the room, interfering with fine decorations, lettering, and dark stage detail despite recognizable furniture and outlines.
Large blocky patches and washed-out contrast obscure the background and facial detail, while the foreground grass and bags remain more legible.
Bicycle lettering, spokes, frame edges, and background buildings are clearly resolved with clean color and well-preserved highlight and shadow detail.
Coarse block artifacts and softness cover both children, flattening facial features and clothing texture while leaving the figures and large patterns recognizable.
Fine grain is visible on walls and shaded areas, but the performer, spectators, graffiti, and furniture retain useful edges and detail.
Dense colored grain affects the whole courtyard and noticeably degrades faces and shaded stage detail, though people and furnishings remain clearly identifiable.
Severe sweeping motion blur erases nearly all fine detail, with grain and a broad bright glare further obscuring the framed content.
Extreme blur reduces the central structure and vegetation to broad soft shapes, removing almost all recognizable surface detail and distinct edges.
Bridge railings, waves, and shoreline remain clear, though dark exposure suppresses detail in the foreground foliage and distant island slopes.
Strong overall blur leaves the structure silhouette and broad bands recognizable but obscures its masonry texture and most foliage detail.
Severe uniform blur removes the building surface texture and architectural details, leaving only broad wall shapes, openings, and color regions.
A blue haze lowers contrast across the shirt and softens its fabric and graphic detail, although the main lettering remains readable.
Faces, hair, clothing patterns, and construction pieces are clearly visible, with only slight softness around moving hands and some foreground pieces.
Heavy grain and softness reduce pavement and grass detail, while the upper portion falls into near-black darkness.
Pronounced blur softens the banana outline, stem, and peel marks, preserving the overall shape but removing most fine subject detail.
The white architectural illustration preserves distinct arches, columns, trim, and signs with clean shapes and smooth gray edge shading.
Grain and mottled color are visible across the ceiling and shadows, with mild softness on faces, while ride outlines and major details remain clear.
